steps.title: Synthesize Phenol-Formaldehyde Resins
steps.instruction: Carry out the synthesis for 5 hours at 75°C.

steps.title: Concentrate the Reaction Mixture
steps.instruction: Cool the reaction mixture to 50°C and concentrate it using a laboratory vacuum evaporator.

substeps.instruction: Continue evaporation until the water content reaches 6-7%.

steps.title: Add Methanol to Product
steps.instruction: Add methanol to the concentrated product at a constant amount of 20%.

steps.title: Analyze Product Resins
steps.instruction: Analyze the resulting resins for compositions and physical-chemical properties.

steps.title: Perform Kinetic Studies
steps.instruction: Conduct kinetic studies by sampling the reaction mixture at specific time intervals.

substeps.instruction: Immediately place each sample in a freezing mixture at approximately -30°C to slow chemical reactions.
Determine the concentration of phenol and formaldehyde using HPLC.
